messages:
Aisha: heads-up — competitor 'NimbusLite' announced a low-cost low-latency endpoint targeting mobile apps. thinking about whether we add a 'Lite' endpoint (lower cost, restricted features) or double down on differentiators (rollouts, observability, routing). need quick tradeoff. what's the priority? :thinking_face:
Jon: saw their post. they do lower qps but claim 30% lower per-token latency by aggressive batching + no streaming. relevant to start-ups.
Priya: technical cost: lite requires a separate lighter runtime path + quantized model variant. risk: regressions and higher maintenance. estimate 3 sprints to ship core + 1 sprint for tests.
Sanjay: customers asking already. a few mid-market trial signups said price sensitivity matters. But enterprises want SLA & rollout features.
Hannah: solution angle: we can offer a 'Lite' SKU on Hosted only (no Dedicated/Private) to limit surface. quick win for growth.
Eve: UX: keep API stable, add parameter like `mode=lite` and a dashboard tag. customers want predictable performance not new parameters.
Jon: if we do lite, we should lock feature gates: no streaming, no function-calls, no long-context to reduce complexity.
Priya: perf numbers I'd expect: ~20-35% cost reduction with int8 + pruning; latency tradeoffs vary by seq len.
Marta: product ask: what's the impact on our positioning? Lite could stop churn but may blur 'production-first' message.
Sanjay: short-term revenue: ✅. long-term: might train customers to expect cheap endpoints and devalue premium SLAs.
Aisha: propose options: A) ship Hosted-Lite asap (3-4 sprints) as growth experiment. B) invest in differentiators (streaming, rollouts, observability) prioritized for Enterprise. C) hybrid: gated Lite for self-serve only + migration path to Dedicated.
Jon: cost to maintain: A ~3 FTE ongoing, B ~5 FTE across infra & console ops, C ~4 FTE plus gating infra.
Hannah: launch criteria for Lite (draft):
- feature set: generation-only, no streaming, no function-calls
- cost delta >= 20% vs current hosted baseline
- rollout controls for customers to opt-in
- clear docs + deprecation path
Priya: quick test plan: perf harness + 2 pilot customers, regression evaller prompt set.
Sanjay: sales asks for pricing anchor and an FAQ for enterprise objections.
Eve: UI microcopy: 'Lite — lower-cost endpoint for low-latency use-cases. Not for mission-critical workloads.'
Aisha: decision needed by EOW so we can plan next quarter. vote/react with :+1: for Lite experiment, :-1: to prioritize differentiators, :shrug: for hybrid.
Marta: also consider product signal: add telemetry flag for any 'lite' requests so we can measure retention/upgrade.
deploy-bot: reminder — weekly roadmap check-in Wed 10am.
Priya: I'll prototype quantized runner spike — ETA 2 weeks.
Jon: I'll estimate infra changes and flag any security/compliance gaps for Private.
Sanjay: I'll draft pricing tiers + enterprise FAQ.
Aisha: thanks — will collect reactions and post decision Thurs.
